name: what3words API
description: The what3words API provides a simple and powerful interface to interact with the what3words addressing system. It allows you to convert between what3words addresses and geographic coordinates, validate and autocorrect user input, and retrieve information about supported languages and the what3words grid. Key features include: - **Convert to what3words address**: Convert latitude and longitude coordinates into a what3words address. - **Convert to coordinates**: Convert a what3words address into latitude and longitude coordinates. - **AutoSuggest**: Suggest valid what3words addresses based on partial or incorrect input, with options to prioritize results by location or restrict results to specific areas. - **AutoSuggest with Coordinates**: Similar to AutoSuggest, but returns coordinates in the response. This endpoint requires special permissions, please contact [support@what3words.com](mailto:support@what3words.com) for more information. - **Grid Section**: Retrieve a section of the what3words grid for a specified bounding box, useful for map visualizations. - **Available Languages**: Get a list of all supported languages, including language codes (including script-specific variants) and native names. For more details, visit the [what3words Public API Documentation](https://developer.what3words.com/public-api/docs#overview). **Run in Postman:** **Additional resources:** - [API Authentication](https://accounts.what3words.com/select-plan?referrer=/public-api/docs) - [Error Codes](https://developer.what3words.com/public-api/docs#error-handling) - [Supported Languages](https://developer.what3words.com/public-api/docs#available-languages) - [Rate Limits](https://developer.what3words.com/public-api/docs#rate-limits) - [API Terms of Use](https://developer.what3words.com/public-api/docs#terms-of-use) - [API Pricing](https://accounts.what3words.com/select-plan?referrer=/public-api/docs) - [Postman Collection](https://openapi.what3words.com/what3words.postman_collection.json) - [Blog: Minimum word and address lengths (code points vs characters)](https://what3words.com/news/blog/minimum-word-and-address-lengths-in-what3words-code-points-vs-characters) - [Blog: Understanding locales in what3words](https://what3words.com/news/blog/understanding-locales-in-what3words) - [Blog: Demystifying the alias parameter](https://what3words.com/news/blog/demystifying-the-alias-parameter-in-what3words-address-urls) - [Blog: LTR and RTL scripts](https://what3words.com/news/blog/how-what3words-addresses-work-in-left-to-right-ltr-and-right-to-left-rtl-scripts) - [Blog: Secondary words across languages](https://what3words.com/news/blog/how-what3words-supports-natural-variants-across-languages-using-secondary-words) - [Blog: Understanding the what3words regex](https://what3words.com/news/general/understanding-the-what3words-regex-a-human-friendly-guide)
